summary: Large shopping-centre car park with no homes nearby; flat bays along the building wall.
reasons: Commercial car park, no dwellings mapped

best_section.where: Bays along the south-west wall of the shopping centre, by the entrance near the 0 m ring

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by shops and other car parks; nearest homes are across the main road, well over 25 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Open sealed car park with marked bays and clear entrances; plenty of room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial on the east side and active shop traffic by day; the wall side is further from the road.
drivers.convention: Retail car park, likely used by shoppers and staff; overnight rules unknown and it may be patrolled.
